edges.cite: Meszaros, xUnit Test Patterns — 'Four-Phase Test' / 'Fixture Setup'
edges.note: Phase 1 (setup) constructs the test fixture the exercise phase runs against.
Hand-written per-behavior assertions vs recorded whole-output comparison as the verification strategy.
Both avoid enumerating expected values by hand: approve recorded output vs assert universal properties.
Generators draw inputs from a seeded PRNG; the seed makes failing cases reproducible/shrinkable.

edges.cite: Nat Pryce, 'Test Data Builders: an alternative to the Object Mother pattern' (2007)
edges.note: Fluent builders with defaults proposed explicitly as an alternative to fixed Object Mother factories.
Object Mother supplies the ready-made example objects that populate a test's fixture.
Builders construct the complex objects that make up the arranged fixture, overriding only relevant fields.
Logic extracted from the humble shell is unit-tested with doubles standing in for the environment.
A Page Object is a Humble Object for the UI: assertion-free wrapper delegating to test logic.
UI/acceptance tests drive pages via the Page Object while stubbing backend services.
The bootloader selects the active slot and performs the handoff to the chosen image.
The newly written inactive slot is signature-verified before the boot selection is switched.
First boot of the new slot is confirmed; a watchdog-forced reset triggers automatic fallback to the old image.
Update software without downtime by in-place code replacement vs whole-image dual-slot swap.

edges.cite: ARM Cortex-M Generic User Guide — VTOR vector-table relocation
edges.note: Handoff relocates the vector table (e.g. VTOR) to the application's before loading SP and jumping.
Boot code validates the application image (signature/hash) before transferring control to it.
Drivers manipulate the device through volatile memory-mapped register reads/writes.
Drivers register and service device interrupts via ISRs for event-driven I/O.
Drivers split handling into a minimal ISR plus deferred task-level work (top/bottom half).
Ping-pong DMA fills one buffer while the other is processed (double-buffered DMA).
DMA completion is signaled by an interrupt handled in an ISR.
Scatter-gather DMA is a descriptor-list form of DMA transfer across non-contiguous buffers.
Offload bulk data movement to the DMA controller vs CPU-driven programmed I/O / polled transfer.
Standard iord/iowr macros on abstract register designators vs direct volatile pointer/overlay access.
Two register-access abstractions: standardized C macros vs compile-time C++ template DSL.
A device-neutral proxy can portably reach registers through the iohw.h addressing interface.
The RAM shadow copy is flushed to the device via a memory-mapped register write.
A proxy keeps a software shadow to support read-modify-write of write-only/volatile registers.
Shadow-plus-register update is guarded against ISR interleaving by briefly masking interrupts.

edges.cite: Pont, 'Patterns for Time-Triggered Embedded Systems' — Super Loop vs TTC Scheduler
edges.note: Bare endless loop vs a timer-driven co-operative scheduler as the application's control structure.
The main loop repeatedly polls task/device flags each iteration.
In a super loop, ISRs are the only asynchronous activity, handing work to the loop.
The ISR queues work; the deferred bottom half runs at task level inside the super loop.
On MCUs without an FPU the PID terms are computed in Qm.n fixed-point integer math.
Output clamping and integrator anti-windup saturate the actuator command to its representable range.
The loop runs at a fixed rate driven by a periodic timer so the dt in the I/D terms is constant.

edges.cite: GoF Adapter; Douglass, Real-Time Design Patterns ('Hardware Adapter')
edges.note: Hardware Adapter is the Adapter pattern applied to a device's actual interface vs the app's.

edges.cite: GoF Proxy; Douglass, Real-Time Design Patterns ('Hardware Proxy')
edges.note: Hardware Proxy applies Proxy: a device-neutral surrogate hiding register layout and access mechanics.
The proxy encapsulates the volatile memory-mapped register pokes behind its neutral interface.
Money is a canonical Value Object: amount+currency with value equality and no identity.
Amounts are stored as scaled integers (minor units) with conserving allocation/rounding rules.
Handle fixed-width overflow by growing to unbounded limbs vs detecting/flagging overflow.
DSP-style fixed-point math clamps intermediate/final results to avoid wraparound on overflow.
Tolerate rounding via an epsilon/ULP band vs rigorously carry error bounds through every op.
Numeric properties are asserted with approximate (epsilon/ULP) equality rather than exact ==.
Accurate summation via a compensation term vs switching to exact higher/arbitrary precision.
Compensated accumulation curbs drift in the PID integrator over long-running float sums.
Bound rounding rigorously with intervals vs eliminate it with exact big-number computation.
Cope with counter overflow by modular wraparound comparison vs never overflowing via bignum counters.

edges.cite: RFC 793 (TCP) sequence numbers; RFC 1982 serial number arithmetic
edges.note: Window comparisons order wrapping fixed-width sequence numbers via modular half-range rules.
A CSPRNG is a PRNG additionally meeting next-bit / state-compromise security requirements.
Lockstep simulations share a seeded PRNG so every peer derives identical random outcomes.
Two responses to a long method: extract intention-named calls in place vs reify it as its own class.
Guard clauses flatten early-exit conditions, helping a composed method stay at one abstraction level.

edges.cite: Fowler, Refactoring 2nd ed. — 'Replace Function with Command'
edges.note: Method Object reifies a computation as an object with locals-as-fields; i.e. a Command object.
One X-macro list expands into parallel enum + handler dispatch tables from a single source of truth.
FSM transition tables and their action/name tables are generated together from one X-macro list.
Keep parallel artifacts consistent from one definition via the preprocessor vs an external code generator.
The never-edited generated base defines the skeleton; the hand-written subclass fills hook methods.
Select variation at compile time via isolated #ifdef abstractions vs at runtime via a toggle.
Confining variants to dedicated files behind common interfaces is a facet of modular C file organization.
The 'abstraction layer' sub-pattern realizes a HAL that hides platform #ifdef variation behind an interface.
Long-lived toggles are best realized by selecting a Strategy implementation rather than inline conditionals.
Percentage rollouts / A-B bucketing hash or randomly assign users to a toggle cohort via a PRNG.
Idempotent headers are a precondition for the header/implementation split of modular C components.
Both are preprocessor-discipline patterns keeping headers/interfaces clean under conditional compilation.
Modular C hides a component's struct layout behind an opaque pointer declared in its header.
OTP release upgrades run code_change under a supervision tree that manages restart on failure.
